approval_source.question_set: Move R03 to Sunday 22 November 15:00-19:00 UTC and T05 to Monday 23 November 15:00-19:00 UTC, with everything else unchanged, while other servers in the shared provider project lack delete protection until about 22 November

reason: At the start of the R03 window, Thursday 19 November 2026 15:00 UTC, three servers of another project in the shared provider account had no delete protection, so load_machines.py up refused to make R03's load machine. They were created on 19 November about 01:16 UTC with a 78-hour watchdog, so they are deleted by about Sunday 22 November 07:16 UTC. They are not the staging run's to change. T05 needs a load machine the same way, so its Friday 20 November window is blocked as well.

decisions.question: When R03 and T05 run
decisions.selected: R03 Sunday 22 November, T05 Monday 23 November
decisions.rule:
- R03 runs on Sunday 22 November 2026, 15:00 to 19:00 UTC.
- T05 runs on Monday 23 November 2026, 15:00 to 19:00 UTC.
- Everything else in P01_T06_HOST_LOSS_R03_T05_RESCHEDULE_2026-11-17, P01_T05_HOST_LOSS_REAL_2026-11-10 and P01_T06_R03_T05_WITHIN_HETZNER_LIMITS_2026-11-13 is unchanged: P01's go at each window, one load machine per window, a 4-hour watchdog, the same floods, rate steps and pass rules.
- If servers without delete protection are still in the account at a window's start, that window does not run and goes back to P01.

accepted_risks: R03 and T05 move three days later, so the measured capacity R06's load thresholds depend on arrives on 23 November.
Another project may start new unprotected servers before Sunday; the window then goes back to P01 again.
